proposed_sites.reason: Module path mcp.server.fastmcp is removed; must become mcp.server.mcpserver. Additionally FastMCP is renamed to MCPServer, so the imported identifier itself must change (Context keeps its name).

proposed_sites.snippet: mcp = FastMCP("MCP Gateway to AWS Lambda")
proposed_sites.reason: Constructs an instance of the renamed class; FastMCP no longer exists under that name and must become MCPServer(...).

tool is an MCP SDK Tool object obtained from mcp_client.get_available_tools() (which wraps ClientSession.list_tools()). In v2 the SDK renames this field from camelCase inputSchema to snake_case input_schema, so this attribute access must become tool.input_schema.
